Although red-tailed hawks are not nocturnal, they typically take advantage of the twilight hours to spot their favorite prey. They can see black and white well enough to also hunt at dusk, when nocturnal wildlife, especially rodents, begin to awaken and move around. Hunting around dusk provides the hawk with a greater choice of prey.
